item.title: Baby - Walkthrough
item.description:
Overview

  • Platform: HackMyVm
  • Difficulty: Easy
  • OS: Linux
  • Attacker IP: 10.0.0.2
  • Target Machine IP: 10.0.0.4

The objective was to enumerate the target, identify the exposed services, gain initial access by uploading a PHP reverse shell through a publicly accessible file manager, and escalate privileges by abusing permissive sudo rules configured for several local users.

Port Scanning

Hosts Entry

I added the machine name to /etc/hosts:

echo "10.0.0.4 baby.hmv" | sudo tee -a /etc/hosts

RustScan

rustscan -a 10.0.0.4 -b 500 -- -sC -sV -A -oN nmap/init
